The woods were home to a curious young girl named Elara, who had always felt an inexplicable connection to this magical place. Every night, she would sneak out of her apartment, her heart pounding with excitement and a tinge of fear. The path to the woods was lined with towering trees, their leaves shimmering in the moonlight like silver confetti.
